content:
marco: heads-up: noticing a p99 latency spike across streaming endpoints since ~2365001200. p95 also creeping. customers report partial streams / truncated responses. seeing increased cache miss rate on prefix-cache (low hit rate ~12%).
incident-bot: ALERT: latency-slo-breach (region: us-west-2) · p99 > 1200ms · affected routes: /v1/stream, /v1/generate · incident severity: P1
anya: oncall here — i'm starting triage. can anyone confirm if there was any prefix-hash rollout in the last 24h?
sophia: i rolled a small prefix-hash tweak this morning at 2364960000 to try reducing collisions for short prompts. rollout was to 30% of prod shards.
todd: on infra side i'm seeing a surge in pageouts on a subset of cache shards — eviction rate up, miss ratio jumped. looks like new hash changed distribution -> hotkeys are overloading some kvbuckets.
marco: logs show lots of streaming stalls with repeated retries: ``[stream-worker] warn: kvcache miss, trying backend fetch (lat=420ms)`` repeated. Also seeing backpressure on request queues.
ya: can we toggle prefetch/warmup for the hot prefixes? what's the quickest mitigations we can run without a full rollback?
sophia: options:
- expand prefix-rollout -> rollback the hash change to previous version (fast but requires deploy)
- enable aggressive prefetch for top-k prefixes (config flip)
- increase cache TTL and reduce eviction for affected shards (risk memory pressure)
- route traffic off hot shards (smart routing) — requires quick routing policy change
anj: (typo) — ignore
marco: i can flip prefetch and TTL on a per-shard basis. preferrable to try prefetch first.
stodd: i'll prepare a routing rule to move 20% of traffic off the hot shards to spare capacity if needed. need a deploy approval for config change.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: config/prefetch-toggle  -> awaiting approval from @sophia or @todd
sophia: approving now. go ahead marco.
marco: flipping prefetch on affected shards: ``curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/cache/patch -d '{"shards": [34,35], "prefetch": "aggressive"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"'``
marco: prefetch enabled. monitoring.
anya: also alerting CS — jess, customer-impact? can you start drafting comms if needed?
jess: thanks @anya. so far small % of streaming sessions drop after ~10-30s. pulling list of impacted customers and usage patterns now. will prep a short note if we need to notify top 5.
marco: metrics after prefetch flip: p99 down from 1550ms -> 980ms within 2m, cache hit rate improved 12% -> 38% for the hot prefixes. p95 stable. good short term.
todd: eviction still elevated but plateauing. i'm going to hold routing change for 10m to see stability.
sophia: we still have a 30% rollout of the new prefix-hash. recommendation: pause further rollout and schedule automated rollback if p99 rises above 1s again. I'll open a rollback PR.
marco: can we capture the exact hotkey distribution? query i'm running:
```
select prefix, count(*) as qps, cache_hit_rate from telemetry.prefix_stats
where timestamp > now() - interval '10 minutes'
order by qps desc limit 50;
```
marco: top 3 prefixes account for ~44% of the requests on those shards — classic hotkey.
anya: jess, any indications customers opened support tickets? we should prioritize ones on dedicated capacity.
jess: one ticket from ACME platform, they're seeing truncation in streaming. flagged as high. i'm escalating to account team and will add mitigation notes.
incident-bot: NOTE: scheduled oncall handoff in 2 hours to night-shift. current oncall: anya -> next: elliot. add runbook link: https://redwood/ops/runbooks/prefix-hotkey
anya: adding runbook steps to thread and tagging next oncall. elliot please watch the p99 trend and be ready to rollback.
marco: logfile snippet from affected worker:
```
[2365001258] worker-34: stream stall detected, fetch backend latency 630ms, kvcache miss
[2365001261] worker-34: retrying stream chunk, queue_len=42
[2365001264] worker-34: successful chunk emit after backend fetch (lag cumulative 1100ms)
```
sophia: created rollback PR: `revert-prefixhash-2026-03-12` — if we rollback, expect transient cold-cache hits but should remove the uneven distribution.
todd: plan B if rollback causes too many cold misses: throttle concurrency on streaming route and enable model-fallback to smaller variant for non-critical customers.
anya: ok we have short-term improvement via prefetch. action items:
- sophia: pause rollout + keep rollback PR open (in progress)
- marco: monitor hit rates and prefetch effectiveness for 30m
- todd: hold routing change unless p99 > 1s again
- jess: prep customer comms and priority notify ACME
- incident-bot: create incident ticket and link to postmortem template
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2365001234 · owners: eng-runtime/sre/ops · severity: P1
marco: i'll leave monitoring hooks and a dashboard link in the handoff notes. current p99: 790ms, p95: 210ms, cache-hit: 41% on affected prefixes.
jess: sending initial heads-up to ACME now. will update with ETA if we rollback.
anya: handing off to night oncall (elliot) at 2365003600. please watch for re-regression and don't hesitate to trigger rollback if p99 climbs back >1s.
elliot: (ack) i'll pick this up for night shift. thanks all. :thumbsup:
marco: final note: archive logs and snapshot prefix map for postmortem. i'll attach snapshots to the incident ticket.
